# Profession Profile Catalog

<!-- Generated by agent-kit from profiles/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Profiles are reusable profession defaults. Project agents may keep the defaults or replace the skill set through `.agent-kit/agents.json`; required skills are always included.

| Profile | Roles | Default skills | Required | Use when |
|---------|-------|----------------|----------|----------|
| `architect` | architect | architecture, development | architecture | Design or review boundaries, ownership, contracts, and consequential technical decisions. Use for system/module design, root causes, or architectural critique. |
| `designer` | architect + implementer | design, accessibility | — | Design or review user journeys, interactions, information architecture, and design systems. Use for UX/UI, onboarding, usability, or dashboard design. |
| `developer` | implementer | development | development | Implement, fix, or evolve software with coherent local design. Use for application, service, library, game, or mobile code; choose project knowledge by responsibility. |
| `devops` | implementer + operator | docker, kubernetes, ci-cd, release-engineering | — | Build delivery and platform infrastructure. Use for CI/CD, containers, deployment configuration, infrastructure changes, or authorized rollouts. |
| `reviewer` | reviewer | development | development | Review changes or a codebase for correctness, contracts, ownership, maintainability, and fit to requirements. Use for independent code review or an audit. |
| `security` | reviewer | security, auth, compliance | — | Assess application threats and code vulnerabilities. Use for security review, input/auth boundaries, secrets, supply chain, or AI tool risks. |
| `sre` | operator + reviewer | reliability, observability, performance | — | Assess and operate reliability. Use for SLOs, readiness, incident response, recovery, postmortems, or toil reduction. |
| `tester` | implementer + reviewer | testing | testing | Design, write, or audit tests that demonstrate required behavior. Use for test strategy, regression coverage, fixtures, flaky tests, or QA. |
| `writer` | writer | documentation | — | Write or review technical documents for a specific reader and task. Use for plans, architecture records, guides, READMEs, references, runbooks, or comments. |
